interpreted_meaning: Base of Renfro Member (Mbr) on top of Nada Member (Mbna). GQ-963 maps Renfro separately; KGS digital compilation merged Renfro into the Slade Formation polygon (Msla), so this line is the mapped Nada/Renfro contact.
Base of Renfro Member (Mbr) on top of Nada Member (Mbna), GQ-649. Glauconitic clayey siltstone seam (to 0.2 ft) marks top of Nada.
Base of Renfro Member (Mbr) on top of Nada Member (Mbna), GQ-900.
Base of Renfro Member (Mbr) on top of combined Nada and Cowbell Members (Mbnc), GQ-686. Upper edge of Mbnc is the top of the Nada.
Base of Renfro Member (Mbr) on Nada Member (Mbna), GQ-685.
Base of Renfro Member on Wildie Member (Mbw). Wildie is the upper-Nada lithosome renamed south of the arbitrary Berea-quadrangle cutoff (Weir and others 1966).
Base of Renfro Member on Wildie Member (Mbw), GQ-684; upper-Nada stratigraphic equivalent.
Top of mapped Renfro+Nada unit (Mbrn), GQ-1285. The Nada/Renfro contact itself is not drawn; it lies one Renfro thickness below this line (Renfro thickest NE, thinnest near Wagersville).
Top of mapped Renfro+Nada unit (Mbrn), GQ-1182. Renfro commonly about 5 ft thick, so the target contact lies a few feet below this line.
Top of mapped Renfro+Nada unit (Mbrn), GQ-1183 (Nada type locality). Renfro commonly about 10 ft thick.
